title: Prove rigidity of the released-terminal P104 BIT scalar gauges
body:
Even with all 32 idle masks and 38 terminal diagonal gauges released, fixed ADD, SWAP, QUERY and LOCAL equations connect all 70 gauge variables to the fixed input. All masks remain unchanged. An independent time-expanded graph checks 30,362 states and 30,694 equality edges; a toy case exercises explicit terminal inverse transport.

Pinned #7830 87fbf4f7b35b0f18ab12b5767775a9a424cf0b15 with prior retiming and source snapshots in the packet. python3 -I -B check.py reproduces exact structural and signed receipts and rejects three injected corruptions. OpenAI Codex assisted. Retained authors credited.

## Open next questions

Compensated gates, changed coefficients, nonlocal cancellations and matrix-valued gauges remain open.
